name: What kind of report will I receive after a siding inspection?

mainEntity.name: What kind of report will I receive after a siding inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a siding inspection, you will typically receive a comprehensive report detailing the findings. This report often includes photographs of identified issues, a description of the damage, and recommendations for necessary repairs or maintenance. It will also outline the overall condition of your siding and any areas of concern, providing a clear understanding of your home's exterior health.
acceptedAnswer.description: You'll receive a detailed report with photos, descriptions of damage, repair recommendations, and an overall assessment of your siding's condition.
